explanation: The statement is about library-specific constructions: `unipotentGL2Hom`, the subgroup `↥(unipotentGL2Hom (R := K)).range`, and the coordinate map `entry`/`ofEntry`/`entryHomeomorph` (all defined in this library, not in Mathlib). Mathlib has only the generic transfer lemmas `MeasureTheory.Measure.isAddHaarMeasure_map`, `AddEquiv.isAddHaarMeasure_map` (to_additive of `MulEquiv.isHaarMeasure_map`, Mathlib/MeasureTheory/Group/Measure.lean:876), `ContinuousMulEquiv.isHaarMeasure_map` and `ContinuousLinearEquiv.isAddHaarMeasure_map`, none of which states this result: to apply one of them here one would first have to build an `AddEquiv` (or `ContinuousAddEquiv`/`ContinuousMulEquiv`) between `Additive ↥(unipotentGL2Hom R).range` and `K` from the library's own `entry_mul`, `entry_ofEntry`, `ofEntry_entry`, `continuous_entry` and `continuous_ofEntry`, which is not routine one-or-two-line glue but a real construction. Grepping Mathlib for `unipotentGL2Hom`, `entry`, `ofEntry` gives no matches, so no Mathlib declaration can state the same result.
